title: Everyday Problems
subtitle: 「日常問題／生活中的小難題」，要先分清是一般困難、可應付的挑戰、實際操作問題，還是瑣碎但令人煩惱的麻煩。
description: 「日常問題／生活中的小難題」，要先分清是一般困難、可應付的挑戰、實際操作問題，還是瑣碎但令人煩惱的麻煩。

words.meaning: 日常困難；每日遇到的小問題
words.example: Many people use apps to manage small daily difficulties more efficiently.
words.exampleZh: 很多人使用應用程式，更有效率地處理日常小困難。

exercises.original: Many people use apps to manage everyday problems more efficiently.
exercises.zh: 很多人使用應用程式，更有效率地處理日常問題。
exercises.upgrade: Many people use apps to manage daily difficulties more efficiently.

options.explanation: manage in ordinary life 表示日常遇到的小難處，daily difficulties 很自然。
crises 程度太嚴重，通常是重大緊急局面。
emergencies 需要即時處理，不是一般日常問題。
complaints 是對問題的不滿表達。
tasks 只是待辦工作，不代表有困難。
stress 是由問題引起的反應，不是問題本身。

exercises.original: Good planning can reduce everyday problems at work.
exercises.zh: 良好規劃可以減少工作中的日常困難。
exercises.upgrade: Good planning can reduce daily difficulties at work.

options.explanation: planning can reduce routine difficulties without implying crisis。
emergencies 通常不能靠一般規劃完全概括。
responsibilities 是工作責任，不一定是困難。
complaints 是反映問題，不是問題本身。

exercises.original: The course helps students cope with everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 課程幫助學生應付日常困難。
exercises.upgrade: The course helps students cope with daily difficulties.

options.explanation: cope with is a natural collocation for daily difficulties。
complaints 不是被應付的根本問題。
stress 可被應付，但不是所有 everyday problems 的同義詞。

words.meaning: 日常挑戰；例行生活中的難題
words.example: Planning ahead can make routine challenges easier to handle.
words.exampleZh: 預先規劃可令日常挑戰更容易應付。

exercises.original: Planning ahead can make everyday problems easier to handle.
exercises.zh: 預先規劃可令日常問題更容易應付。
exercises.upgrade: Planning ahead can make routine challenges easier to handle.

options.explanation: easier to handle + routine context supports challenge framing。
responsibilities 可以是 routine，但不一定是 challenge。
tasks only 只表示工作，不表示難度。

exercises.original: Parents face many everyday problems when routines change.
exercises.zh: 日常作息改變時，家長會面對很多日常挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: Parents face many routine challenges when routines change.

options.explanation: parenting routines generate manageable recurring challenges。
emergencies 不應泛化日常育兒問題。
complaints 不是育兒難題本身。
responsibilities only 未必表示有挑戰。

exercises.original: New staff often need help with everyday problems in their first weeks.
exercises.zh: 新員工最初幾週常需要協助應付例行挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: New staff often need help with routine challenges in their first weeks.

options.explanation: first-week routine adaptation fits routine challenges。
crises 不符合一般入職適應。
tasks only 只指工作事項。

words.meaning: 日常困難；平常生活難處
words.example: Good communication helps families deal with everyday difficulties.
words.exampleZh: 良好溝通有助家庭處理日常困難。

exercises.original: Good communication helps families deal with everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 良好溝通有助家庭處理日常困難。
exercises.upgrade: Good communication helps families deal with everyday difficulties.

options.explanation: families + ordinary life is a direct fit for everyday difficulties。

exercises.original: The guide discusses everyday problems faced by older adults.
exercises.zh: 指南討論長者面對的日常困難。
exercises.upgrade: The guide discusses everyday difficulties faced by older adults.

options.explanation: faced by older adults in ordinary life naturally maps to everyday difficulties。

exercises.original: Technology can help people overcome some everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 科技可以幫助人們克服一些日常困難。
exercises.upgrade: Technology can help people overcome some everyday difficulties.

options.explanation: overcome difficulties is a natural collocation。
stress may be reduced, but it is not the problem itself。

words.example: The guide offers practical solutions to common household problems.
words.exampleZh: 指南為常見家居問題提供實用解決方法。

exercises.original: The guide offers solutions to everyday problems that many households face.
exercises.zh: 指南為很多家庭常見的問題提供解決方法。
exercises.upgrade: The guide offers solutions to common household problems.

options.explanation: many households face is the direct clue for common problems。
emergencies are not necessarily common or routine。

exercises.original: These everyday problems affect many new users.
exercises.zh: 這些常見問題影響很多新使用者。
exercises.upgrade: These common problems affect many new users.

options.explanation: many new users indicates widespread frequency。
complaints may be submitted by users but are not the technical problems themselves。
responsibilities do not fit users here.

exercises.original: The workshop covers everyday problems that most students encounter.
exercises.zh: 工作坊涵蓋大部分學生都會遇到的常見問題。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop covers common problems that most students encounter.

options.explanation: responsibilities may be common but are not problems by definition。
stress is not the underlying problem.

words.meaning: 日常問題；日常瑣事中的難題
words.example: Managers spend much of their time dealing with day-to-day problems.
words.exampleZh: 管理人員花很多時間處理日常問題。

exercises.original: Managers spend much of their time dealing with everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 管理人員花很多時間處理日常問題。
exercises.upgrade: Managers spend much of their time dealing with day-to-day problems.

options.explanation: managerial routine operations strongly support day-to-day problems。
crises only would imply constant serious emergencies。
complaints only are just one source of problems。
tasks only are work items, not necessarily problems。

exercises.original: The team meets briefly each morning to discuss everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 團隊每天早上短會討論日常問題。
exercises.upgrade: The team meets briefly each morning to discuss day-to-day problems.

options.explanation: each morning is a direct clue for day-to-day operational issues。
emergencies should not be routine agenda items。
tasks only are agenda work, not necessarily problems.

exercises.original: The system handles most everyday problems automatically.
exercises.zh: 系統可自動處理大部分日常問題。
exercises.upgrade: The system handles most day-to-day problems automatically.

options.explanation: automatic handling implies ordinary recurring operational problems。
crises cannot normally be fully automated as routine。
complaints are user reports rather than all system problems。
responsibilities do not fit system errors。
stress is not applicable to system operation.

words.meaning: 實際問題；現實中的難題
words.example: The move created several practical problems with transport and storage.
words.exampleZh: 搬遷在交通和儲存方面帶來數個實際問題。

exercises.original: The move created everyday problems with transport and storage.
exercises.zh: 搬遷在交通和儲存方面帶來實際問題。
exercises.upgrade: The move created several practical problems with transport and storage.

options.explanation: transport and storage are concrete implementation issues。
complaints may result but are not the logistical problems。
tasks are actions to complete, not necessarily problems.

exercises.original: They discussed everyday problems such as childcare and travel arrangements.
exercises.zh: 他們討論育兒和交通安排等實際問題。
exercises.upgrade: They discussed practical problems such as childcare and travel arrangements.

options.explanation: childcare and travel arrangements are real-world practical matters。
responsibilities may relate but do not capture the problem-solving aspect.

exercises.original: The project looked good on paper but caused everyday problems during implementation.
exercises.zh: 項目紙面上很好，但實施時出現實際問題。
exercises.upgrade: The project looked good on paper but caused practical problems during implementation.

options.explanation: during implementation is a direct clue for practical problems。
complaints only are a possible consequence。
tasks are work to be done。
responsibilities are not the same as implementation difficulties.

words.example: We had a few minor problems with the booking system.
words.exampleZh: 預約系統出現了幾個小問題。

exercises.original: We had a few everyday problems with the booking system.
exercises.zh: 預約系統出現幾個小問題。
exercises.upgrade: We had a few minor problems with the booking system.

options.explanation: a few + booking system suggests limited-severity issues。
complaints may be reported because of the problem but are not the problem itself。
responsibilities do not fit system faults.

exercises.original: The device works well despite some everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 裝置雖有一些小問題，但整體運作良好。
exercises.upgrade: The device works well despite some minor problems.

options.explanation: works well despite issues indicates the issues are limited in severity。
emergencies would likely prevent normal operation。
crises are not appropriate for a device。

exercises.original: Most everyday problems were fixed in the first update.
exercises.zh: 大部分小問題在首次更新中已修正。
exercises.upgrade: Most minor problems were fixed in the first update.

options.explanation: fixed in an update suggests limited software issues。
crises is inappropriate for routine bug fixes。
major failures would be more severe and likely require stronger wording。
stress is not a software issue.

words.example: Online services can reduce some everyday hassles.
words.exampleZh: 網上服務可減少一些日常麻煩。

exercises.original: Online services can reduce everyday problems such as queues and paperwork.
exercises.zh: 網上服務可減少排隊和文書等日常麻煩。
exercises.upgrade: Online services can reduce everyday hassles such as queues and paperwork.

options.explanation: queues and paperwork are small annoying inconveniences，hassles 很自然。
responsibilities may involve paperwork but are not the hassle itself。
complaints can result from hassles but are not synonymous。
tasks are neutral and lack annoyance.

exercises.original: Commuting creates many everyday problems for city workers.
exercises.zh: 通勤為城市上班族帶來很多日常麻煩。
exercises.upgrade: Commuting creates many everyday hassles for city workers.

options.explanation: commuting delays and inconvenience fit hassle well。

exercises.original: The app removes some everyday problems from shopping.
exercises.zh: 這個應用程式減少購物過程中的一些日常麻煩。
exercises.upgrade: The app removes some everyday hassles from shopping.

options.explanation: shopping friction and inconvenience are classic hassles。
responsibilities do not fit shopping friction。
complaints are not the inconvenience itself。
stress only is an effect rather than the underlying hassle.

words.meaning: 日常挑戰；每日要應付的難題
words.example: New parents often face many day-to-day challenges.
words.exampleZh: 新手父母經常面對很多日常挑戰。

exercises.original: New parents face many everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 新手父母面對很多日常挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: New parents face many day-to-day challenges.

options.explanation: parenting has recurring, manageable challenges rather than constant crises。
responsibilities only do not capture difficulty。

exercises.original: The job involves everyday problems that require flexibility.
exercises.zh: 這份工作涉及需要彈性處理的日常挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: The job involves day-to-day challenges that require flexibility.

options.explanation: require flexibility suggests recurring challenges in normal work。
tasks only could be routine without difficulty。
stress is not the challenge itself.

exercises.original: Carers often need practical support with everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 照顧者常需要實際支援應付日常挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: Carers often need practical support with day-to-day challenges.

options.explanation: carers face recurring ordinary challenges, making day-to-day challenges natural。
crises only is too narrow and severe。
emergencies only are not the routine burden。
tasks may be part of care but lack difficulty meaning。
responsibilities are obligations, not necessarily challenges.

words.example: The book focuses on ordinary problems rather than major crises.
words.exampleZh: 這本書集中處理一般問題，而不是重大危機。

exercises.original: The book focuses on everyday problems rather than major crises.
exercises.zh: 這本書集中處理一般問題，而不是重大危機。
exercises.upgrade: The book focuses on ordinary problems rather than major crises.

options.explanation: direct contrast with major crises means ordinary normal, non-exceptional。

exercises.original: The service is designed for everyday problems, not exceptional cases.
exercises.zh: 這項服務是為一般問題而設，而不是特殊個案。
exercises.upgrade: The service is designed for ordinary problems, not exceptional cases.

options.explanation: not exceptional is the direct clue for ordinary problems。

exercises.original: Most people can solve these everyday problems without specialist help.
exercises.zh: 大部分人毋須專業協助也可解決這些一般問題。
exercises.upgrade: Most people can solve these ordinary problems without specialist help.

options.explanation: without specialist help suggests normal, non-specialist problems。
complaints are not the underlying problems。

words.meaning: 每日瑣碎麻煩；日常煩惱
words.example: Small daily hassles can build up and increase stress.
words.exampleZh: 日常小麻煩累積起來可以增加壓力。

exercises.original: Small everyday problems can build up and increase stress.
exercises.zh: 日常小麻煩累積起來可以增加壓力。
exercises.upgrade: Small daily hassles can build up and increase stress.

options.explanation: small + build up + stress is classic daily-hassles language。
crises are individually serious rather than small accumulating irritants。
tasks may create workload but are not inherently hassles。

exercises.original: Traffic delays are one of the everyday problems that annoy commuters.
exercises.zh: 交通延誤是令通勤者煩惱的日常麻煩之一。
exercises.upgrade: Traffic delays are one of the daily hassles that annoy commuters.

options.explanation: annoy commuters directly supports hassle/annoyance meaning。
emergencies are too severe for ordinary delays。
complaints may follow delays but are not delays themselves。

exercises.original: Researchers studied how everyday problems affect mood.
exercises.zh: 研究人員研究日常小麻煩如何影響情緒。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers studied how daily hassles affect mood.

options.explanation: psychology research on mood often uses daily hassles for recurring minor stressors。
crises are severe life events, a different category。
responsibilities may cause stress but are not synonymous。

words.example: The workshop covers everyday issues such as budgeting and time management.
words.exampleZh: 工作坊涵蓋預算和時間管理等日常問題。

exercises.original: The workshop covers everyday problems such as budgeting and time management.
exercises.zh: 工作坊涵蓋預算和時間管理等日常問題。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop covers everyday issues such as budgeting and time management.

options.explanation: budgeting and time management are neutral everyday issues, not necessarily failures。
stress may arise from these issues。
tasks only is too narrow because budgeting is broader than a single task.

exercises.original: The guide gives advice on everyday problems at home and work.
exercises.zh: 指南就家居和工作中的日常事項提供建議。
exercises.upgrade: The guide gives advice on everyday issues at home and work.

options.explanation: advice on broad routine matters suits the softer word issues。
emergencies are not the general focus。
responsibilities only are one subset of issues。

exercises.original: The podcast discusses everyday problems without treating them as crises.
exercises.zh: 播客討論日常問題，而不把它們說成危機。
exercises.upgrade: The podcast discusses everyday issues without treating them as crises.

options.explanation: the explicit desire for softer framing makes issues ideal。
complaints are not the topics themselves。
stress is only one possible topic/outcome。
responsibilities are duties, not all issues.

words.example: The programme teaches practical ways to solve problems of daily life.
words.exampleZh: 這項計劃教授解決日常生活問題的實際方法。

exercises.original: The programme teaches practical ways to solve everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 這項計劃教授解決日常生活問題的實際方法。
exercises.upgrade: The programme teaches practical ways to solve problems of daily life.

options.explanation: this is a transparent explanatory paraphrase of everyday problems。

exercises.original: Technology can simplify many everyday problems.
exercises.zh: 科技可以簡化很多日常生活中的問題。
exercises.upgrade: Technology can simplify many problems of daily life.

options.explanation: general explanatory context suits the phrase problems of daily life。
emergencies are not generally 'simplified' in this broad sense。
tasks only are not necessarily problems。

exercises.original: The book offers advice for everyday problems faced by families.
exercises.zh: 這本書為家庭面對的日常生活問題提供建議。
exercises.upgrade: The book offers advice for problems of daily life faced by families.

options.explanation: family daily-life context fits a transparent descriptive paraphrase。
crises would narrow to severe situations。
responsibilities are duties rather than problems。

falseSynonyms.zh: 危機不等於 everyday problem crisis 是嚴重、緊急、可能需要立即處理的局面；日常問題通常沒那麼嚴重。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A crisis is urgent and serious; an everyday problem is usually routine.

falseSynonyms.zh: 緊急事故不等於 everyday problem emergency 需要迅速回應；日常問題通常不具緊急性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An emergency requires immediate action.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不便不等於所有 everyday problem inconvenience 只是造成麻煩或不方便；有些日常問題比不便更嚴重。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An inconvenience is one kind of minor problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 投訴不等於 problem complaint 是對問題的不滿或正式申訴，不是問題本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A complaint reports dissatisfaction; it is not the underlying problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 任務不等於 problem task 是要完成的工作；它可以很簡單，未必有任何問題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A task is work to do, not necessarily a difficulty.

falseSynonyms.zh: 責任不等於 problem responsibility 是需要負責的事情；有責任不等於遇到困難。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Responsibility is an obligation, not a problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: 壓力不等於 problem stress 是心理／身體反應；日常問題可以造成壓力，但兩者不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stress can result from everyday problems.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 problem 是名詞；problematic 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Problem is a noun; problematic is an adjective.
